meaning:
ἐγκόπτω, see: ἐνκ-.
ἐν-κόπτω (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν; and in I Pe, l.with, ἐκκ-);
1. to cut into (as in breaking up a road), hence, 2. to hinder: with accusative Act.24:4, 1Th.2:18, . inf., Gal.5:7; before τοῦ, with inf., Rom.15:22; εἰς τό, with inf, 1Pe.3:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.
Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
